notes.harness: headless Chrome (CDP) against pnpm dev + browser IPC fixtures; scrollbars NOT hidden in this run (first run used --hide-scrollbars), so the collapsed-rail numbers include any real scrollbar gutter
notes.collapsedRail: maxCentreOffsetPx = max |button centre - panel centre| over every rendered nav/footer button (rail scrolled to top and to bottom); scroller.horizontalOverflow = scrollWidth - clientWidth; canScrollX = scrollLeft after trying to set 50
notes.focusRingClearance: ringLeft/RightClearancePx = space between the 2px+2px-offset outline and the rail scroll box edge (>= 0 means not clipped by overflow-x-hidden)
notes.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce emulated via Emulation.setEmulatedMedia; transition-duration resolves to 1e-05s (the app-wide 0.01ms reduced-motion rule); the nav width has no transition of its own and jumps 208 -> 56 in one frame (no intermediate widths, no running Animation objects). Baseline without the preference: nav items 0.15s on scale/background/color/border only, still no width transition.
